scope: Independent measurements of actual decoded production JPEGs against original JPGs. Selected generatedPNG and predicted affine deltas are not used for measured boundaries.
method: Both compared at814x1417 (source9_1 is normalized from951x1654); Lanczos for source resizing. Parchment vertical geometry via RGB edge/color profiles,6 columns upper ribbon and8 lower scroll. Full-width median edge excludes highlights/faces. JPEG lower-top search uses original lower-top +/-18px to avoid unrelated golden tabletop (6_2); a measured boundary near that window edge requires visual review. Positive delta means down/right. Upper top andbottom, lower top andbottom are separately measured.

criterion.rationale: Strict operational placement tolerance, not pixel-identical natural parchment edges. Measurement uncertainty about2-3px vertically. Horizontal bounds excluded due dark roll contour ambiguity.

limitations: Automated actual-JPEG measurement needs visual check on strict exceptions, particularly2_2 and6_2.
A passing edge placement result does not certify artwork, typography, JPEG quality, color, or cropped content.
Dark folded scroll right edges can change contour selection; horizontal differences do not establish actual translation.
